Samir — preliminary answers below (will follow up with a short one-page price range and SOC2 + architecture links):
- Ballpark: For a pilot at ~50k tokens/day we typically see monthly costs in the $8k-$18k range depending on batching, model choice, and whether you want low-latency (single-token p95 under 250ms) or cost-optimized (quantized model) serving. We'll provide a 1-page band with typical configurations.
- SSO/KMS: Redwood supports SAML SSO and customer-managed KMS for key wrapping; we also document encryption-at-rest and audit logs for Private deployments in the SOC2 pack. We'll attach the SOC2 summary and architecture note in the next message.
